verdict.rationale: Brex's API/docs confirm automatic receipt-to-transaction matching ("Upload receipt and match automatically" and pre-signed S3 upload that tries to match existing expenses), and its AI feature page claims agents can 'fetch receipts' and file expenses automatically, plus a review agent that 'follows up with anyone out of compliance.' However, there's no explicit evidence of e-receipts being pulled automatically from third-party integrations (e.g., travel/vendor e-receipt feeds) nor documentation describing smart nudging logic that only triggers when a receipt is genuinely missing rather than generic compliance follow-ups. missing for 10: explicit e-receipt integration sourcing, documented logic for suppressing false-positive missing-receipt nudges, independent user confirmation of matching accuracy.
